chapters.title: First Sight
chapters.text: Fresher's day. She was sitting alone at the front desk — black jeans, pink top. I noticed her eyes first: sharp, alive, like mirchi. The kind of eyes that stay with you long after you've looked away. I didn't know it then, but I was already a little lost.

chapters.title: The Ignore Phase
chapters.text: Every morning I'd say Hi. Every morning she'd look at her desk, her phone, the wall — anywhere but me. Too shy to make eye contact, I'd later learn. But back then? I thought I was invisible. Funny how the universe makes you chase what's meant for you.

chapters.title: Freshers Party
chapters.text: And then the night she changed everything. She walked up to me first — said Hi. My heart did something stupid. We danced. Lights too loud, music too fast, but none of that mattered. It was the night the story really began.

chapters.title: Getting Comfortable
chapters.text: Second semester. Our first photo together — just our hands, side by side. Small, quiet, ours. I still look at that picture and feel exactly the same warmth I felt the moment it was taken.

chapters.title: The Wait
chapters.text: Last day of semester one. I looked for her everywhere just to say goodbye. She'd already left for CP with friends. I didn't tell her, but I waited. Longer than I should have. That's probably when I knew — this wasn't just anyone I wanted to say bye to.

chapters.title: Reconnect
chapters.text: I saw her Instagram story. Texted her — once, twice, more. She was busy; the replies were slow. I told myself she wasn't interested. I was wrong. Some connections just need patience. She was always there.

chapters.title: Falling
chapters.text: Semester two. Our old friend circles quietly fell apart, and somehow we fell toward each other. Physics, Electrical — classes side by side, every day. I started looking forward to those hours more than anything else. That's what falling feels like, I think. Slow, then all at once.

chapters.title: First Kiss
chapters.text: Semester three. Things got lighter, warmer, braver. And then one day — a kiss. First, quiet, real. The kind you don't forget. The kind you replay. I haven't stopped.

chapters.title: First Date
chapters.text: We kissed a lot after that. Laughed a lot. Talked about everything and nothing. Sometimes I'd catch myself wondering why she doesn't write things down the way she used to — all those feelings, unrecorded. Then I'd feel a strange ache, like I wanted to keep every version of her safe.

chapters.title: 3 Years — June 15, 2026
chapters.text: The video call. Her packed bags. The empty cupboard where her things used to be. I don't think I was ready for how heavy that silence was. Three years of proximity folding into a screen, a signal, a timezone gap. Long distance started that day.

chapters.title: The Promise
chapters.text: Long distance is hard. For both of us, in different ways — different clocks, different silences. But this is what I know: I'm not going anywhere. Trust me, one day I'll give us the life we've always dreamed about. The real one. Together.

chapters.title: Today
chapters.text: You are the best. My girl. Happy Birthday — I hope this little corner of the internet feels even half as warm as you make me feel every single day. 💖
